Covers every section in order: nitrogen and its preparation, reactivity of N₂, ammonia (basicity, NH₃/NH₄⁺ shapes, laboratory synthesis and test), oxides of nitrogen, NOₓ sources, photochemical smog and PAN, catalytic converter, nitrification and denitrification, sulfur (properties, catenation, oxidation states, Frost diagram, reactions, uses, organic sulfur compounds) and sulphuric acid (contact process, physical and chemical properties, uses). Numericals use changed amounts and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: balanced NH₄NO₂ and NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ equations (CaCl₂ forms), NH₄NO₃, NO = nitric oxide with 11 valence electrons, Pt/Rh, OONO₂ in PAN, gypsum CaSO₄·2H₂O, pyrite FeS₂ with 4FeS₂ + 11O₂, V₂O₅ → V₂O₄, Zn + 2H₂SO₄, ethene (g), sulfonamides vs beta-lactams. The printed 77.67 % and 35.67 % usage shares and the 'cold conc. acid gives SO₂' sentence are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
